Name: XposedOrNot
Author: XposedOrNot - help@xposedornot.com
Description:
The [XposedOrNot](https://xposedornot.com) solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests breach exposure data for your verified domains and raises incidents when new exposures appear, so compromised accounts can be remediated before they are abused.

**Key Features:**
- Breach exposure monitoring for every domain verified in your XposedOrNot account
- Incidents for new breach exposures, with severity raised for plaintext and easy to crack passwords
- Configurable refresh schedule and API key entry on the data connector page
- Workbook for breach exposure analytics, risk breakdown and trends

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

a. [Codeless Connector Framework (CCF)](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector)

b. [Azure Monitor Data Collection Rules](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/essentials/data-collection-rule-overview)
WorkbookBladeDescription: This Microsoft Sentinel Solution installs a workbook that provides breach intelligence visualization including exposure analytics, risk breakdown, and timeline views.
AnalyticalRuleBladeDescription: This solution installs an analytic rule template that detects new breach exposures for your monitored domains. After installing the solution, create and enable the analytic rule in Manage solution view.
